cases.findings: Curly fine hair and glasses silhouette retained across sampled motion; soft edge detail visible on checker/black/white. No claim of exact fine-hair recovery without GT.
Face, ears, beard and clothing remain solid in sampled alpha. Initial native review crop clips some head top at frame0; final reel uses documented wider ROI for whole hair/beard.
Ear motion, short fur and facial outline remain visible across samples. Feathered/soft boundary is retained; individual-fur completeness cannot be scored without GT.

Checker is visible through the real sheer fabric; folds have changing alpha and moving edges. Background probe is a local diagnostic only and may include dark screen/spill or occlusion; no accuracy score.

Sofa and draped textile remain opaque; hard/soft edges preserved. A faint tracking-marker residue is visible in early samples on black. No manual marker removal. Wider reel ROI approved to include moving sofa/textile boundary.
Both heads and separate hair silhouettes retained with a clear gap. Review ROI crops parts of faces at some extremes; full-source view remains available. No invented whole-frame GT.
Two profiles, gray hair and loose hair preserved in sampled consecutive frames. No obvious sampled one-frame separation failure; this is not a numerical flicker verdict.
Bin, fingers and white-shirt/arm boundaries remain solid; real gaps between arm and body are cut out. Portrait full view plus selected hand/bin ROI is intentional.
